_comment: The shelves of every library, whatever the profile: the letter of a code, the folder in library, the name in English and Russian, what goes there and the genres (doc_type of schemas/card-1.json) that go there. Every genre is on exactly one shelf, so the shelf follows from the genre (Claude may put a document elsewhere with a note). The same shelves everywhere keep the codes of libraries and base packages compatible.

shelves.about: Standards and norms: national, interstate and international standards, codes of rules, standards of organizations and guidelines.
Books one reads or looks things up in: monographs, textbooks, handbooks, theses, lecture notes.
Documents of projects and work: design and working documentation, reports, drawings, presentations, data sets.
Documents of equipment and products: datasheets, operation manuals, questionnaires, catalogs of products.
Legal acts and regulations: laws and rules of authorities, process regulations, clinical guidelines, contracts, court decisions.
Issues of journals and other serials, proceedings of conferences, single articles and papers.
Whatever fits no other shelf; the card says why in its note.
